overview.blossoms.baseGainHint: The first Q earns its base gain. Further Q hits on your existing Combo also earn the configured T6 refund. Heavy Light grants the configured full-combo total across its three actual hits; missing hits earn no gain. These base amounts are adjustable assumptions, not verified game values. Q after Combo expires loses the T6 bonus. Common extra gain is added on top; balances are capped at 100.
overview.blossoms.cadenceHint: Cadence assumption from the reference video: one impact per 0.5 s cycle, plus a second impact 0.15 s later while your Lingering Bone is active. First impact: 0.35 s after launch. Lingering Bone also increases consumption from 10 to 20 Blossoms/s and doubles projectile damage. Base cadence and projectile travel remain unverified; impacts after depletion are not modeled. The video shows 140 Attempts in 60 s; the imported file has four launch entries and a shorter duration. This is a comparison target, not a forced hit count.
overview.blossoms.chargedHit: Additional gain per Spring Away hit
overview.blossoms.chart: Blossom balance across the selected rotation
overview.blossoms.directHit: Common extra gain per umbrella hit
overview.blossoms.exhaustedHit: Refund per drone hit on Exhausted boss
overview.blossoms.gainHint: Q provisionally grants 25 base Blossoms per hit; a full Heavy Light grants 25 in total. Other unknown gains default to 0. T6 models 25 Blossoms per Spring Sorrow cast hitting your existing Combo, requiring Blossom Barrage tier 6. Fan, Mystic, launch and DoT hits do not trigger this T6 refund. This scope follows the Spring Sorrow paragraph in imported game text; exact Global timing remains unverified. Spring Sorrow charges and cooldown reduction are not simulated. Exhausted-boss drone hits refund 3 by default, while consumption continues. Saved overrides are preserved. After depletion or recall: +15, once per 5 s. A depleted drone stays off until another funded launch.
overview.blossoms.heavyLightCast: Heavy Light base gain, full combo (assumption)
overview.blossoms.noResourceRotation: Select 2.0 DH · Blossoms above, or use UmbDroneLaunch in a custom rotation. Legacy fixed-hit variants retain their old behavior.
overview.blossoms.patchNote: Blossom Barrage T4 now boosts both Spring Away and Unfading Flower by 5%, or 10% against Exhausted Combo targets. T5 uses Direct Critical Rate. T96+ Frequent Projectile attunement covers both skills in 2.1.
overview.blossoms.scope: These saved settings change the DPS simulation for UmbDroneLaunch. The curve follows actual hits, consumption and refunds. The dashed line marks the 50-point launch requirement.
